content: Namo ratnatrayāya!Possessing the glory of an ocean of boundless qualities,You who regard all helpless beings as your only child,Sugatas of the three times, together with your sons and disciples,Please turn your attention to this, my truthful lamentation!The complete teaching of the Sage, which dispels the suffering of existence and peace,May the glory of benefit and happiness flourish throughout the vast world!May the learned and accomplished masters who uphold these teachingsCause the activities of the ten religious practices to increase!Completely overwhelmed by fierce and inexhaustible negative karma,Pitiful beings are tormented by incessant suffering;May all the terrors of unbearable disease, weapons, and famineBe pacified, and grant us relief in an ocean of joy and well-being.In particular, for the beings of the Dharma-land of Tibet,Who are being mercilessly destroyed by the dark forces of the barbarian hordes—May their stream of blood and tearsSwiftly cease; rouse the power and force of your compassion!Driven mad by the demons of mental afflictions,These objects of compassion who ruin both themselves and others through their reckless conduct—May these masses of unruly beings gain the eye of discernment regarding what to adopt and abandon,And be joined with the glorious excellence of loving-kindness and friendship!The long-cherished and heartfelt goal,The glory of a completely free and independent Tibet,And the festival of a spontaneously present union of spiritual and temporal life—Grant us the good fortune to enjoy these right now!For the sake of the Teachings, those who uphold them, the government, and our own people,Having completely surrendered their cherished bodies, lives, and possessions,Those individuals who undergo hundreds of hardships—May they be cared for by the compassion of that Protector of Potala!In short, by the power of the Protector Avalokiteśvara,Before the Victors and their heirs, for the Land of Snows,May the vast prayers of total commitment that were madeSwiftly manifest their excellent results here and now.Through the profound interdependent nature of appearance and emptiness,Through the power of the Triple Gem’s compassion and the force of words of truth,And by the power of the infallible truth of karma and its results,May this prayer of truth be swiftly accomplished without hindrance!
